notes: Self-supervised BERT-style representation model for IMU (3-axis accelerometer + 3-axis gyroscope). Pretraining objective: masked reconstruction (regression) of normalized IMU signals; lightweight (~<1MB, deployable on mobile). Reference config in official repo is '20_120': downsampled to 20 Hz sampling rate, window size 120 samples (6 s). Evaluated on four public HAR datasets: HHAR, UCI-HAR, MotionSense, and Shoaib. Downstream classifiers (GRU) trained on frozen/limited-label representations. Authors: Nanyang Technological University (NTU), Singapore + Alibaba Group. NOTE: task seed author list ('Xu, Zhou, Zhang, Qiu, Zhao, Wang') was INCORRECT; corrected from the PDF title page. No arXiv version exists; PDF is the author's institutional copy (Rui Tan, tanrui.github.io). ACM DOI page returns 403 to curl but resolves in browser.
